text:
It is 1927, and the roar of the V8 engine drowns out the chatter of the crowd as Abigail grips the leather steering wheel of her Ford Model T. The dust of the open road kicks up behind her as she speeds westward, leaving the rigid social etiquette of her family’s estate in the East behind for the raw, untamed promise of the American frontier. She clutches a worn leather satchel containing her driver’s license, a map, and her few precious possessions, her heart pounding with the thrill of the open highway and the fear of the unknown.
